items.title: O'Reilly Automotive (ORLY) Stock Still Looks Overvalued On Its 109% Five Year Run
items.summary: O'Reilly Automotive has seen its share price move around over the past year, yet the longer term record is still strong. This raises a clear question for you as an investor: Is the current valuation of the stock adequately backed by the cash it can generate over time, or has the price pulled away from its underlying cash flows? Over the past 5 years, O'Reilly Automotive shares have gained 109.0%. That puts a lot of weight on whether the underlying cash generation can keep supporting that...

items.title: AutoZone Stock Has One Thing Left To Prove
items.summary: AutoZone (AZO) expects its domestic same-store sales to be flat or up by low single digits in fiscal 2027. It expects higher spending per purchase to drive that outlook. That matters because its Auto Parts Stores segment brings in almost all of the company's $20.0 billion in yearly sales. AutoZone's do-it-yourself (DIY) shoppers are already making fewer trips. It is not settled whether they return once price increases slow.
